issue.title: preview-day-strip.cjs fails four 410px screenshot-day cells: only 2 roots fit (want at least 3)
issue.description:
`node scripts/preview-day-strip.cjs --out <dir>` (bob-plugins) exits 1 with four failures:

    410px light screenshot-day: screenshotDay shows 2 roots at 410px (want at least 3)
    410px light screenshot-day-roots: screenshotDay shows 2 roots at 410px (want at least 3)
    410px dark screenshot-day: screenshotDay shows 2 roots at 410px (want at least 3)
    410px dark screenshot-day-roots: screenshotDay shows 2 roots at 410px (want at least 3)

The other 260 cells pass and there is no overflow. The bob-cli-fl.6.1 land agent reproduced
the identical four failures on 2026-11-02 at 806ba69 (HEAD), at 75e7875 (before the
bob-cli-fl.6.1.5 Day strip hint), and at the pre-bob-cli-fl.6.1 base 71ae1cb. The cause
predates bob-cli-fl.6.1. bob-cli-fl.6.1.5 saw the same failures and called them
pre-existing in its close note, but filed no follow-up.

Root cause not yet identified. Either the screenshotDay fixture's root labels or the
root-legend fitter now fits only two roots at 410px, or the harness's ≥3-roots
expectation is stale. Bisect between the last green run (bob-cli-bz.2 recorded 84 cells,
0 failures) and 71ae1cb, then fix the fitter, the fixture, or the expectation as the
Day strip contract in bob-cli docs/stats.md requires.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Identical four failures on three trees (806ba69, 75e7875, 71ae1cb) in consecutive runs, and the harness otherwise completes in about 9 s with 260 passing cells; the failure follows the code, not load.

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-fl.6.1 land agent found the Day strip browser preview red on every tree back to the pre-epic base, and no task tracks it. The red gate makes each Day strip change re-prove that these failures are pre-existing.
